Our work is shaped by a global perspective that comes from OVER two decades inside the fashion world. We are a boutique team of artists, colorists, and thinkers who create prints with emotion and commercial clarity. Every design starts by hand painted, inked, collaged, sketched before moving into a refined digital world where craft meets innovation. What defines us is our eye: a signature sense of color, depth, and mood that translates into prints that feel modern, wearable, and deeply human. We partner closely with leading brands to create exclusive artwork that elevates collections, builds identity, and helps product truly connect with the people who wear it. We don’t chase trends we interpret them through our own lens. The result is artwork that feels emotional, intentional, and forward thinking. PHILOSOPHY Print is emotion. It’s the story a garment tells before a word is spoken, the atmosphere it creates, and the feeling it carries through color, texture, and form. Our philosophy is simple: Thoughtful design lasts. Taste is INHERENT. And the human hand still matters. We blend craftsmanship with technology to create prints that are both visually striking and commercially successful. Each artwork is built with intention considering silhouette, fabrication, color harmony, and the final customer experience. We design with the future in mind: prints that photograph beautifully, translate across fabrics, work globally, and support a brand’s aesthetic identity. Above all, we believe that prints should invite emotion; joy, nostalgia, boldness, serenity because these feelings are what make people reach for our designs again and again. “Liz Casella is THE destination for print design and inspiration. Their dedication to quality, curiosity and integrity sets them apart in every way. I have been a client for several years and Liz Casella is my go to & the first on my list when in need of print and pattern. They are exceptional at tuning into what is going on in fashion, art, music and culture and are excellent at translating them into modern, elevated and commercially viable designs. The team goes beyond “just a print”, you also get beauitful colorways, and a bonus of layers and a repeat!. Liz Casella is one of the GOAT regarding print design.” -CINDY HOWLETT, DESIGN DIRECTOR “Working with LiZ and her team is always such a pleasure.” Liz has impeccable taste and extensive knowledge of print, fabric and color play. She’s attuned to trends across multiple fashion categories and has the ability to translate them through her own distinct point of view. I respect and admire her work and love the collaborative exchange of ideas that makes selecting seasonal prints both fun and inspiring. DESIGN CATEGORIES INCLUDE OUR PRINTS ARE HERE TO MAKE LIFE EASY FOR OUR CLIENTS. Made to Print. Built to Flex. QUICK SPECS | NO FUSS ONE OFF - ORIGINAL DESIGNS FROM OUR IN-HOUSE TEAM OF ARTISTS. LIFETIME OWNERSHIP | YOUR ARTWORK | YOUR ASSET SEAMLESS REPEATS + ADJUSTABLE TILE. SCALE IT UP OR DOWN, IT ALWAYS WORKS. PRINTS ARE SUPPLIED AS PSD FILES WITH 300DPI RESOLUTION | SRGB COLOR FORMAT. REPEATS WITH MOTIFS ARE BUILT IN OBJECT LAYERS SO ITS EASY TO MOVE THINGS AROUND. (DYES, TEXTURES, ANIMALS, SOME GEO’S AND PLAIDS CAN BE THE EXCEPTION WITH FEWER LAYERS.) PRINTS COME COLOR SEPARATED SO YOU CAN CHANGE THE COLORS TO YOUR NEEDS. (HIGHLY DIGITAL STYLES SUCH AS PHOTO-REAL EFFECTS AND OMBRES MAY BE FLAT. NEED SEPARATING ANYWAY - TELL US HOW MANY COLORS AND WE’LL INCLUDE THE COLOR LAYERS IN THE ORIGINAL DESIGN FEE.) LIZ CASELLA SIGNATURE ALL DESIGNS ARE UNIQUE AND COME WITH LIFETIME OWNERSHIP. DESIGNS COME IN REPEAT, OBJECT LAYERS AND COLOR SEPARATIONS. VIEW DESIGNS ONLINE VINTAGE COLLECTION BEAUTIFUL PIECES SOURCED FROM AROUND THE GLOBAL. OUR VINTAGE IS AVAILABLE TO VIEW IN-PERSON. BOOK TO VIEW IN-PERSON KNEELAND CO. VINTAGE WE SHOW KNEELAND CO. VINTAGE IN LOS ANGELES AND NEW YORK INPERSON AND ONLINE. WE PROUDLY DONATE FROM THE SALE OF EACH PRINT TO UNICEF FOR CHILDREN AND ONE TREE PLANTED © 2026 LIZ CASELLA LLC
